$comment: Intended Phase 2 differences between the original storefront (baseline commit) and the working tree. Every entry needs a reason. Format: tools/README.md. Anything that differs and is not listed here fails `npm run test:regression`.

newPages.reason: S9 branded 404 (ui-kit): prerendered /404, served by the static host for unknown URLs
M3 /order?no=&t= shell (storefront-checkout): client-rendered order status page
M7 policy pages render only once the owner publishes them (storefront-account)
M7 policy pages render only once the owner publishes them (storefront-account)
M7 policy pages render only once the owner publishes them (storefront-account)

rules.reason: app.html loads the Phase 2 stylesheets after wefeasto.css (storefront-checkout / storefront-account)
ui-kit: hamburger hidden without JS (it needs JS to open the sheet)
ui-kit: PeepStrip band hidden without JS
storefront-account: /login?verify=<token> carries a token in the URL; never leak it via Referer
storefront-checkout: checkout.js is loaded on Pay; preconnect in the /checkout head
ui-kit MobileNav: hamburger (<=991px) + separator in the nav icon row; there was no mobile navigation
ui-kit MobileNav: fixed sheet host outside .page-wrapper
M9 PeepStrip (1:1 bublr crowd, 350px) between the page and the footer (hidden on /checkout, /login, /order, /reset-password)
ui-kit: the Mix colors pill is not rendered on /cart, /checkout, /order (it covered the order summary / pay button)
M8 quick fix: LCP hero image eager + fetchpriority=high (was loading=lazy)
M6: #newsletter anchor for links/emails
M6 newsletter via Payload: state hook for tests
M6: honeypot field (bots), visually hidden
hunt client-ux prehydration-forms-native-submit: Webflow's method=get → post, so a native submit can never put the email address in a URL
hunt client-ux prehydration-forms-native-submit: Submit disabled until hydrated (a native submit before that subscribed nobody), like /checkout's Pay
M6 double opt-in: success copy is now 'Check your inbox to confirm…'
ui-kit / M8: PDP eyebrow shows the product's own category (was hard-coded 'Oats & Muesli' on every PDP)
S7 buy-direct perks line
M7 product facts <details> after PartnersDropdown (only facts that exist)
S10 recipe rail: one-tap add of the featured product

hunt client-ux add-to-cart-is-a-link (sf-core): the Webflow <a href="#"> Add to Cart acts and never navigates, so it is exposed as role=button (WCAG 4.1.2) and Space adds like a native button; same element, classes and hooks
S3: the prototype notice 'accounts arrive in Phase 2' is gone (notice starts empty)
S3 real accounts: panels are now forms with forgot-password panel, hints, busy states (storefront-account §2); covered by e2e/ui/account.spec.js
SPEC §0: 'Continue with Google' hidden until OAuth exists
hunt client-ux (sf-checkout, round 4): the customer fields sit in a <fieldset> that is disabled while the payment window opens, so edits can't be silently ignored
M2: server-matching length limits and mobile keyboards on the checkout fields
hunt client-ux pin-with-space-truncated (sf-checkout): maxlength 7 so a PIN typed as printed ("560 001") fits; the space is dropped before validation
M2: phone is a 10-digit Indian mobile (+91 added by the page)
M2 email + state + consent, S1 save details (storefront-checkout §5)
S5: PIN first so city/state can autofill from it
SPEC §0: card and UPI data never in our forms; the 'Prototype — no real payment' note is gone
M2 trust line + WhatsApp help (S12); no-JS note
M2 amount-in-button Pay: disabled until hydrated/quoted
M2 Pay button styling hook
PI-EXP-4: the trailer's wrapper clips its scroll parallax (scale 1.06 → 1) so it can't widen the page; same 16:9 geometry, the 1px border moved from the <video> to the frame
M2: 'Place Order' → 'Pay securely' (prerendered, no amount: never 'Pay ₹0')
M3: the fake 'Order confirmed' block moved to /order (real order status)

visual.$comment: JS-off screenshots. rules: mode 'hide' = display:none (intended additions/removals; layout collapses back), 'mask' = visibility:hidden (changed in place, layout kept). thresholds: maxDiffRatio per page/viewport (default 0.001 = 0.1% of pixels).

rules.reason: hunt client-ux prehydration-forms-native-submit: newsletter Submit stays disabled until hydrated, so with JS off it shows dimmed (opacity .8)
S7 perks line (addition)
M7 product facts (addition)
PDP eyebrow = the product's own category (text changed)
S10 recipe rail add button (addition)
Mix colors pill not rendered on /cart, /checkout (ui-kit)

hunt w5 client-ux colormix-covers-footer-social: wherever the Mix colors pill is rendered, the footer ends with a band as tall as the pill's footprint (52px, 58px below 480px) so the fixed pill no longer covers the Instagram/YouTube icons and legal line at the end of the page; hiding the band restores the baseline layout (measured in e2e/ui/colormix-footer.spec.js)
S3 real account forms (DOM-allow-listed; covered by e2e/ui/account.spec.js)
'Continue with Google' hidden until OAuth exists
M2 email/state/consent, S1 save, trust line, no-JS note (additions)
card/UPI inputs and the prototype note removed (SPEC §0)
S5: PIN and City swapped
phone placeholder changed (10-digit mobile)
Pay button: 'Place Order' → 'Pay securely', disabled until ready
M7 / ui-kit: static/images/webclip.png is now the Wefeasto mark (was Webflow's logo); it is the recipe author avatar on recipe pages and the home recipe cards
autoplaying (muted) videos play without JS too and are captured at a random frame; the <video> element, poster and sources are compared by the dom phase
PI-EXP-4: the home trailer's 1px border is drawn by its clipping frame now, not by the (masked) <video>; masking the frame covers the same 16:9 box the baseline masks

hunt r4 a11y-motion mobile-nav-our-story: #about ("Our Story") is shown below 480px now (webflow.css hid it), so the mobile menu's, hero's and footer's /#about links land on it; the baseline has no section there, so the current side hides it and the rest of the page must still match

interact.$comment: Observations that differ on purpose. Each entry pins the value on each side (a key absent on one side is null). Every other observation must be identical.

coSummaryRows.reason: M1 honest totals: a Delivery row in every summary (free over ₹499)

coFakeThanksOnCheckout.reason: M3: no fake 'Order confirmed' on /checkout; confirmation lives on /order

coCardUpiInputs.reason: SPEC §0: card/UPI data never in our forms (Razorpay collects it)

coNewFields.reason: M2 email + state + consent, S1 save details

coInvalidMarked.reason: M2: invalid fields get aria-invalid + inline errors (baseline relied on native validation)

coPathAfterPlace.reason: M3: placing an order goes to /order?no=&t= (stubbed API)

coRequest.reason: M2: real POST /api/store/checkout (SPEC §6 body, Idempotency-Key uuid v4, E.164 phone, server-checked total)

coOrderView.reason: M3 /order confirmed view from the (stubbed) status endpoint

noticeText.baseline: Prototype only — accounts arrive in Phase 2 ✨
noticeText.reason: S3: the prototype notice is gone; the current text is the signup validation message (pinned via signupInvalidMarked)

signupInvalidMarked.reason: S3: empty signup is refused client-side with field errors

noticeAutoHidden.reason: S3: error notices stay until the next action (the prototype notice auto-hid after 3 s)

googleButton.reason: SPEC §0: 'Continue with Google' hidden until OAuth exists

newsletterRequest.reason: M6: newsletter posts to /api/store/newsletter (honeypot 'website' empty), nothing goes to webflow.com

mixPillOnCart.reason: ui-kit: the Mix colors pill is not rendered on /cart, /checkout, /order (an active mix stays applied: mixStateOnCart must still match)

nofx.$comment: Kill-switch probes (mode + page → {before, afterNav, errors}) must match the baseline unless pinned here: 'mode page': {current, reason}.

smoke.$comment: JS-on page loads with no CMS: errors not seen on the same baseline page fail unless matched here ({pattern, reason}). Also fails on new horizontal overflow (scrollWidth > clientWidth) at any width.

visualJs.$comment: JS on, ?nofx=1 + prefers-reduced-motion (deterministic, no intro animations), /api = no CMS. Covers client-rendered UI the JS-off pass can't see (cart rows, summaries, hydrated nav). targets: {page (build-relative, for rule globs), route, seed (localStorage), name}.
